shared_elements: non-figural curvilinear/linear marks on natural rock surfaces
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry schematic human-derived motifs applied to natural rock, a near-universal trait; A's large curvilinear masks, spirals and concentric-circle eyes have no counterpart in B, and B's tiny row of stick-limbed figures with a larger cross-barred figure and boat-like sign has no counterpart in A. The manner of depiction is opposite in kind: A uses bold, plastic, curvilinear compositions filling each boulder face, while B uses thin, sparse, linear stick-figures scattered across an open expanse.
